senses.gloss: m. (חָתַן) marriage; wedding ceremony, only in pl. חִיתּוּנִים, חִיתּוּנִין.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 3:11">Cant. III, 11</cite>) <he>ח׳ היו וכ׳</he> the law-giving on Sinai was a wedding (between God and Israel), as we read (<cite ref="Exodus 19:10">Ex. XIX, 10</cite>) &c., v. <he>קִידּוּשִׁין</he>; Pesik. Vayhi, p. 5ᵃ; Cant. R. to l. c. <he>כחתנים</he> (corr. acc.).
